CustomField.label: Month Names
CustomField.description: Twelve pipe-separated months in order, January first. A month may list comma-separated spellings, the first being canonical: Marz,Maerz,Mrz. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive, on the whole name or on any prefix of three letters or more that only one month answers to — so a prefix two months share (Portuguese ma for marco and maio) is reported, never guessed. Blank means the language cannot read MMM/MMMM.
